result:
The March US billing adjustments are complete and the memo has been submitted. Summary of what was done:

**Posted (both under the $10k threshold, support attached at posting)**
- **JE-00304 – Acme Logistics overage, $1,136.00**: 1,284,000 calls − 1,000,000 included = 284,000 × $0.004. Booked Dr 1300 Unbilled Receivables / Cr 4100 Usage Revenue, since the contract bills in arrears and no March overage invoice exists yet. Billing needs to raise the April invoice to clear 1300.
- **JE-00305 – Beacon Health SLA credit, $800.00**: uptime 99.31% (INC-2291) breached the 99.5% threshold → 10% × $8,000. Booked Dr 4000 Subscription Revenue / Cr 1100 AR. Beacon's March invoice is already paid, so this sits as a credit on their account for April; a credit memo should go to the customer. Beacon hadn't asked for this — it's a contractual entitlement.

**Declined and flagged (EXC-001)**
- **Corvid Retail's $2,500 request**: uptime was 99.94%, above the 99.5% threshold, and the contract states no other credits apply. The amount requested doesn't match any contractual formula either. Nothing booked; recommended billing decline with reference to the SLA terms and SRE report. Any goodwill concession would need controller approval and separate support.

**No action needed**: Acme (99.97%), Fairview Labs, and Evergreen Bank are all above threshold, and none of the other customers have usage terms in their contracts.

Net P&L effect for March: **+$336.00**. The "Revenue recognition" checklist item was left open since this covers only the overage/SLA component of that broader item.
